cpuRuns.scope: actual minimal DOS boot, original protected-mode loader, host monotonic wall time, no SDL
actual minimal DOS boot, original protected-mode loader, host monotonic wall time, no SDL

coverageNotes: Driver profile success requires exact guest-file PASS records, not load banners.
Mouse test injects PS/2 motion behind a blocking guest readiness fence and requires nonzero driver motion counts.
DHCP requires an acknowledged offer and committed IPADDR 10.0.2.15/GATEWAY 10.0.2.2; no public host is contacted.
XMS moves and compares 8192 bytes; EMS writes/remaps/compares four complete 16 KiB pages.
ATA PIO IDENTIFY and sector read are tested separately from DOS file I/O, whose block driver uses BIOS INT13.
All CPU intervals have independently calculated checksums; 1024-loop runs are acceptance tests, not performance scores.
The parent disk hash is checked before/after every driver run; successful child overlays are removed.
Each sourceCommit/gitCommit is the repository base at run start; frozen executable/ROM/probe hashes identify actual inputs, including concurrent work.
QEMU VGA comparisons retain the independent IBM text oracle and four-byte-aligned DISPI display-start comparison rules.
limits: JEMMEX uses an explicit EMS frame: I=E000-EFFF FRAME=E000 X=C000-DFFF X=F000-FFFF. Writable ISA upper-memory/ROM regions prevent reliable automatic hole discovery.
Not every x86 instruction, FreeDOS driver, UMB discovery path or physical raster/timer behavior is covered.
ATAPI/CD-ROM, USB and sound driver support is not claimed by this matrix.
